A '''precision hyperspace jump''', also known as a '''micro-jump''', was a tactical jump into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] over a very short distance, often within a single [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. The [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] would launch into hyperspace and allow a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] to pull it back out. Some pilots utilized the gravity-well generated by a [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projector]] to drop into an area, such as a battlezone. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] performed a precision jump to survive the [[Battle of Praesitlyn]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used the tactic while battling the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] while defending [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]]. The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] had perfected performing micro-jumps even without a planet or gravity-well nearby.

Pilots often used a slower back-up hyperdrive when making a micro-jump as it allowed for more accuracy. Additionally, should the jump damage the hyperdrive, it was cheaper to replace.<ref name="SoF">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref>

The precision hyperspace jump was a way of appearing behind an enemy blockade of a planet. It involved coming out of hyperspace past the enemy blockade, but was risky as it could have resulted in the user colliding with nearby objects. It took considerable piloting skill. During the Battle of Gwori, the pilots had to be careful as the gravity fluctuation could have pulled them into the planet or they could have hit a [[Separatist cruiser]].

Anakin Skywalker used a micro-jump as a way of appearing undetected, close up to an enemy ship at the [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|Battle of Saleucami]]. Instead of coming out past the blockade, he flew to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] command ship undetected, dropping out of hyperspace close to his target, then slowing to a stop.

Later, in [[41 ABY]], [[Marr Idi-Shael]]; a talented mathematician and a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], used a precision hyperspace jump to bring the [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Junker'']] close to the [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] undetected without the use of a gravity-well.
